reply: Acme Cloud is a customer analytics platform for B2B software companies. It connects product usage, billing, and CRM data into one live model of every account, user, and dollar, then turns it into dashboards, smart alerts, and AI-powered insights. Teams use it to spot churn risk earlier, find expansion revenue, and avoid rebuilding reports in spreadsheets weekly. It serves revenue operations, customer success, product, and finance teams at B2B SaaS companies (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 1-2).

The Starter plan costs $49 per user per month. It includes up to 10 users, 5 data sources, 1 million events per month, ready-made dashboards, and email support with next business day response. It is designed for small teams replacing spreadsheet reporting. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

The Growth plan costs $99 per user per month and includes unlimited users, 25 data sources, 20 million events per month, AI insights and smart alerts, custom health scores, and priority support with a 4-hour response time. It is designed for scaling companies running revenue and product on data. The plan also offers a 60-minute onboarding call and near real-time data sync. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

The Starter plan includes 1 million events per month. If you go over this monthly event limit, Acme Cloud will contact you to discuss moving to the next plan. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3)

Yes, Acme Cloud offers a 14-day free trial for the Starter and Growth plans with no credit card required. The Enterprise plan starts with a 30-minute demo with the team. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)
Annual billing saves 15% compared to monthly billing for Acme Cloud plans. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

Your data is never used to train AI models shared across customers. Acme Cloud ensures that your data and questions remain private and are not used for training shared AI models (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3).

Your data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest with AES-256 encryption. This ensures secure handling of your data both while it is being transferred and when it is stored. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)
You can choose EU hosting for your data residency when you sign up with Acme Cloud. This ensures your data is hosted in the EU. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

Acme Cloud connects natively to several CRMs including Salesforce and HubSpot. It also integrates with other tools like Stripe, Chargebee, Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, Zendesk, Intercom, and Slack. Data syncs every 15 minutes on the Starter plan and in near real time on Growth and Enterprise plans (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 2).

SSO (SAML) is included in the Enterprise plan. This plan also offers SCIM user provisioning, custom data retention, a dedicated customer success manager, and a 99.99% uptime SLA. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3)

Most teams see their first live dashboard the same day they connect a data source. Starter customers onboard with self-serve guided setup, Growth customers get a 60-minute onboarding call, and Enterprise customers receive a dedicated customer success manager with a structured 30-day rollout plan (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3-4).
Acme Cloud's pricing is listed in US dollars and excludes applicable taxes. There is no mention of payment options in Indian rupees. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3)
The Growth plan includes 25 data sources. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

Acme Cloud has native connectors for several tools including Stripe, Chargebee, Salesforce, HubSpot, Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, Zendesk, Intercom, and Slack. Zoho CRM is not listed among the native integrations. Product events can also be sent through SDKs or the REST events API. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 2)

There is no mention of an on-premise version of Acme Cloud for installation on your own servers in the product guide. The platform is described as cloud-based with data residency options in the US or EU. If you need more specific details, I can connect you with our team who can help.
